skill.name: ai-paper-writer
skill.description: Draft, edit, and improve academic papers based on user requirements, including citation formatting and a final writing review. Trigger keywords: write a paper, draft a paper, academic writing, edit a paper, revise a paper, improve a paper, polish a paper, 论文写作, 写论文, 撰写论文, 论文修改, 论文润色, 学术写作。
skill.summary: Draft and revise academic papers with clarified requirements, standard citation formatting, and a final writing review.
skill.author: notegpt-official

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no findings, so no static verdicts are required. The reviewed skill contains only academic writing instructions. No evidence found of prompt injection, data exfiltration, or executable behavior.

content.value_statement: Academic paper drafts need clear requirements, consistent citations, and careful revision. This skill guides drafting, editing, citation formatting, and a final writing review.
actual_capabilities: Ask follow-up questions about academic level, paper type, word count, citation style, visualization needs, and output format.
Draft academic papers according to user requirements.
Edit and improve existing paper drafts.
Use standard citation styles when citations are required.
Review drafts against relevant writing guidelines.
Revise the draft before delivering the final version.
limitations: No source retrieval or citation verification workflow is included.
No scripts, document export tools, or chart generation tools are bundled.
Writing reviews do not guarantee factual accuracy, originality, or acceptance by a journal or institution.
Results depend on the host model and the requirements, source material, and guidelines supplied by the user.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Coursework Draft
use_cases.description: Turn an assignment brief and approved notes into a paper draft matched to the required length and citation style.

use_cases.title: Revise a Manuscript
use_cases.description: Improve an existing manuscript and review its consistency with supplied journal writing guidelines.

use_cases.title: Polish Academic Language
use_cases.description: Edit a paper for clear academic language while preserving the intended argument and supplied references.
use_cases.target_user: Scholars writing in an additional language

prompt_templates.title: Clarify Paper Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a paper about [topic]. Ask about academic level, paper type, word count, citation style, visualization needs, and output format before drafting.

prompt_templates.title: Draft From Supplied Notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a [word count]-word [paper type] for [academic level] using the notes and references below. Use [citation style] and flag missing evidence. Materials: [notes and references].
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: create a draft from existing material.

prompt_templates.title: Revise an Existing Paper
prompt_templates.prompt: Revise this paper for clarity, flow, and academic tone. Preserve the argument and supplied citations. Apply [writing guidelines] and review the revision before delivery. Draft: [text].
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: improve a manuscript without changing its intended claims.

prompt_templates.title: Review Against Submission Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this manuscript against [journal guidelines], [citation style], and [word limit]. Revise supported issues and list unresolved requirements. Do not invent evidence or bibliographic details. Manuscript and references: [materials].
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate revision, citation formatting, and a final requirements review.

output_examples.input: Help me write a paper about remote learning. I have not chosen a length or citation style.
output: What academic level and paper type should this address?
What word count and citation style are required?
Do you need charts or data visualizations?
What output format and writing guidelines should I follow?

output_examples.input: Improve this sentence without adding claims: Online classes are good because people can do them at different times.
output_examples.output: Online classes offer scheduling flexibility, allowing learners to participate at different times.

output_examples.input: Review a draft against guidelines requiring a stated objective, a 150-word abstract, and consistent APA citations. The abstract is 180 words.
output: The abstract exceeds the requested limit by 30 words and needs revision.
The objective and citation consistency cannot be assessed without the draft and reference list.

best_practices: Provide the assignment or journal guidelines, academic level, word count, citation style, and desired output format.
Supply source material and complete reference details, then verify every citation and factual claim.
Review the final draft yourself and follow applicable institutional policies on AI assistance.
anti_patterns: Requesting invented sources, fabricated results, or citations unsupported by supplied material.
Treating a writing review as proof of factual accuracy, originality, or publication readiness.
Expecting automated research, chart generation, or document export from this prompt-only skill.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides academic paper drafting, editing, citation formatting, and a final review against relevant writing guidelines.

faq.question: What happens when my requirements are unclear?
faq.answer: It asks about academic level, paper type, word count, citation style, visualization needs, and output format.

faq.question: Can it revise a paper I already wrote?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the draft and the writing requirements you want applied.

faq.question: Does it find and verify academic sources?
faq.answer: No source retrieval or verification workflow is included. Provide reliable references and check all citations yourself.

faq.question: Does it include chart generation or document export?
faq.answer: It asks about visualization needs and output format, but includes no chart generation tools or document exporters.

faq.question: Which AI tools are listed as supported?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Output quality depends on the host model and supplied materials.
